name: SS Espagne
builder: Chantiers & Ateliers de Provence, Port-de-Bouc · yard no. 30
summary: A French Line ocean liner built for Compagnie Générale Transatlantique and completed in 1910. Although overshadowed by larger French prestige liners, she is historically useful as a practical CGT vessel serving Caribbean, Central American, Mediterranean-adjacent, and transatlantic work across the prewar, wartime, and interwar periods.
